picks.title: Epic Games delays Disney game and tells developers to go "AI first"
picks.excerpt: Epic Games has delayed its upcoming Disney collaboration - a shooter featuring characters from the Marvel and Star Wars…
picks.rationale: Major studio formally shifting production to an AI-first model, with a flagship project delayed. Biggest games-industry AI story of the day; trade-press source chosen over the IGN/Polygon copies of the same story.

picks.title: Dragon Quest Creator Yuji Horii Thinks AI Is Amazing As He No Longer Needs To Code Or Draw To Make A Game
picks.excerpt: Yuji Horii released a Claude-driven adventure he says took about 30 minutes, saying AI means he no longer needs to code or draw to make a game.
picks.rationale: Legendary designer ships a game he says he built with Claude in 30 minutes. A concrete release, not just an opinion. Kotaku chosen from the cluster because it names the tool, and it adds a fifth outlet.

picks.title: Square Enix re-launches 'Collective' co-publishing operation, featuring game developed with generative AI
picks.excerpt: Today, Square Enix revealed that its publishing partnership with Vaultbreakers developer BetaDwarf will be part of a "re-launch" of its Square Enix Collective operation, which co-published games with…
picks.rationale: A major Japanese publisher relaunches its indie label around a game openly made with generative AI. It shows where publishers will accept AI-built work.

picks.title: Flathub walked back their generative AI ban, replaced with a disclosure policy
picks.excerpt: Back in May, GamingOnLinux reported how Flathub had near-enough banned generative AI for app / game submissions, but they've mostly walked it back.
picks.rationale: A storefront policy change: the near-ban is replaced by mandatory disclosure. This directly affects how developers who use AI can submit and label their games.

picks.title: 넷마블넥서스의 AI 코딩 도구 도입기 – 게임 개발팀의 Kiro 도입 및 활용 여정
picks.excerpt: 넷마블넥서스 게임 개발팀이 AI 코딩 도구 Kiro를 도입해 스펙 기반 개발과 코드 생성에 활용한 과정과 효과를 정리한 사례.
picks.rationale: A first-hand case study of a Korean game team adopting spec-driven AI coding with Kiro. This is the most practical pick for developers and adds a Korean production angle.

alternates.title: Tencent tests AI gaming companion that responds to live gameplay
alternates.excerpt: Tencent is recruiting closed-beta testers for Goose Dimension, a product described in local reports as an AI game companion. It reportedly supports voice
alternates.rationale: Closed beta of Tencent's live-gameplay AI companion; new product, but two weeks old.

alternates.title: Gears of War: E-Day Gets a Fan-Made Russian AI Dub
alternates.excerpt: E-Day launches with voices in 11 languages but only subtitles in Russian. A fan project's AI dub filled the gap first, and players are split.
alternates.rationale: A fan-made AI dub fills a missing localization for a AAA launch; a concrete AI-localization case.

alternates.title: The happiest man in gaming hates generative AI
alternates.excerpt: Dwarf Fortress creator Tarn Adams on bloated AI-generated code, why he refuses generative AI in his work, and surviving on Steam.
alternates.rationale: Interview with Tarn Adams of Dwarf Fortress; distinct from the Punk Games showcase story it was loosely matched to, but opinion-only.
